title: 第9章 十道灵根第10章 复仇之始
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 噬神塔恢复正常，仓木剑神的枯骨，依旧盘坐在苍茫大地上。
唯一的变化就是，他那瞪大的双目，闭合上了。
想来，应该是将自己心中最后一个遗愿托付给了秦易，彻底安心了。
嗡！
虽然仓木剑神彻底陨落了，但是他的残念消散之前，将先天剑种，赠予了秦易。
此刻的秦易。
脑海中，有一个剑形物体悬浮，晶莹剔透，散发着磅礴的剑道气息。
“这是？”
秦易能清晰的感觉到，这个剑形物体，让他对剑道的感悟，达到了一个全新的高度。
“这是剑道圣物，先天剑种。”塔灵对着仓木剑神的方向，微微躬身，以表敬意。
对于那些为了众生而修行的英雄们，值得所有人尊敬。
随后。
塔灵解释道：“剑种，顾名思义，是剑道种子，只要拥有此种，就能在剑道上大放异彩。”
世间的剑种分为两种。
其一，是普通剑种。
其二，便是先天剑种。
普通剑种，是通过后天修炼，在剑道上的造诣，达到匪夷所思的地步，才有可能衍化出剑种。
拥有剑种，方可踏上剑道巅峰。
而先天剑种，无法人为制造，这是修行者从一出生，就拥有的东西。
放眼诸天万界。
拥有先天剑种者，也只有仓木剑神一人。
而他，最后成为了万人敬仰的一代剑神。
获取先天剑种，只有两个方法。
其一，就是伴生。
其二，就是赠予。
秦易便是属于后者，仓木剑神将其先天剑种赠予他。
先天剑种已经认他为主，与他的血肉，深深的烙印在了一起。
从此以后。
他也是一位先天剑种拥有者。
听完塔灵的解释后，秦易大骇，没想到仓木剑神居然赠予了自己这么珍贵的东西。
先天剑种！
他心意一动，催动先天剑种。
刹那间，木剑颤抖，爆发出了雷鸣般的声音。
紧接着，秦易便不由自主的施展出了《离火剑术》。
咻！
一剑劈出，百丈焰浪。
秦易继续劈出第二剑。
刹那间，百丈焰浪奔腾而过，席卷整个噬神塔第一层空间。
轰轰轰！
震耳欲聋的声音，响彻天际。
焰浪直达千丈！
塔灵见状，感叹道，“不愧是剑道圣物啊，真是厉害。”
秦易还想劈出第三剑，但奈何无论他如何挥舞木剑，焰浪的长度停留在了九千丈。
content_en:
The God-Eating Tower returned to normal, and the withered bones of Cangmu Sword God were still sitting cross-legged on the vast land.
The only change was that his widened eyes closed.
Thinking about it, he should have entrusted the last wish in his heart to Qin Yi, and he was completely relieved.
Buzz!
Although Cangmu Sword God completely died, before his residual thoughts dissipated, he gave the innate sword seed to Qin Yi.
Qin Yi at this moment.
In his mind, there was a sword-shaped object suspended, crystal clear, exuding the majestic aura of kendo.
"This is it?"
Qin Yi could clearly feel that this sword-shaped object brought his understanding of the way of the sword to a whole new level.
"This is a sacred object of swordsmanship, an innate sword species." The tower spirit bowed slightly in the direction of Cangmu Sword God to show respect.
Those heroes who practice for the sake of all sentient beings deserve respect from everyone.
Subsequently.
Ta Ling explained: "Sword seed, as the name suggests, is the seed of kendo. As long as you have this seed, you can shine in kendo."
There are two types of swords in the world.
One is an ordinary sword type.
The second is the innate sword species.
Ordinary sword types can only be developed through acquired practice and attainment in the swordsmanship to an incredible level.
Only by possessing the sword species can you reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship.
The innate sword species cannot be manufactured artificially. It is something that practitioners have from birth.
Look across the universe.
There is only one person with the innate sword seed, Cangmu Sword God.
And he eventually became a sword god respected by thousands of people.
There are only two ways to obtain the innate sword species.
One is companionship.
The second is giving.
Qin Yi belongs to the latter, and Cangmu Sword God gave him his innate sword seed.
The innate sword species has recognized him as its master, and is deeply imprinted with his flesh and blood.
From now on.
He is also an innate sword type owner.
After listening to the tower spirit's explanation, Qin Yi was horrified. He did not expect that Cangmu Sword God would actually give him such a precious thing.
Innate sword species!
With a thought, he activated the innate sword seed.
In an instant, the wooden sword trembled and a thunderous sound erupted.
Immediately afterwards, Qin Yi couldn't help but perform the "Lihuo Sword Skill".
call out!
A sword struck out, causing a hundred-foot-long wave of flames.
Qin Yi continued to strike with the second sword.
In an instant, a hundred-foot wave of flames rushed past and swept through the entire first floor of the God-Eating Tower.
Boom boom boom!
The deafening sound resounded throughout the sky.
The flame waves reach thousands of feet!
Seeing this, the tower spirit sighed, "It is indeed a sacred object of swordsmanship. It is really powerful."
Qin Yi wanted to strike out with the third sword, but no matter how he swung the wooden sword, the length of the flame wave stayed at nine thousand feet.
